reviews_captured_by_me.text: Morris Finishing Company just finished refinishing our kitchen cabinets and we couldn't be happier. They were extremely easy to work with, communicated exceptionally, and were very professional and detail oriented while they completed the project. Thank you Chuck, Susan, and Mike for everything!

We bought a house with ugly red maple cabinets, so we wanted to bring the kitchen into 21st Century. We called Susan and Chuck at Morris Finishing and they walked us through the process. They made it easy. We picked our color and Chuck and Mike made it happen. They were very diligent and conscientious. The whole process takes about a week but the look is worth the wait. Chuck and Mike are men of goodwill and are honest and trustworthy. I would recommend them highly. We are amazed at the transformation.

Morris Finishing Company painted the interior of our Cape Cod style home. Not only did Chuck and his crew do an outstanding job,  but they were also very polite and trustworthy.    Chuck offered suggestions and helped us choose colors that created amazing results!  If you are looking for high quality results from a professional and honest company, please give Morris Finishing Company a call. You will not regret it!
